refusal: billing update states no field
status: lifecycle: unknown billing lifecycle "paused"
status: lifecycle: billing lifecycle is required

case: offer with a trial and a withheld reason
refusal: trial must be false while trialWithheld is set
trialWithheld: unknown billing allowance withheld reason "unverified_email"

case: auto-refill amount not in whole dollars
refusal: billing update: autoRefill: amountMicros must be a positive whole number of dollars
billing update: spendCapMicros must not be negative

case: auto-refill on while the cap is removed
refusal: billing update: autoRefill can be enabled only with spendCapMicros set

case: plan named by its display name
refusal: plan: billing plan "Max" must be 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and underscores, beginning with a letter
idempotencyKey must be at most 64 bytes
amountMicros must be a positive whole number of dollars
status: usedMicros must not exceed allowanceMicros
status: plans must list the plan in force, "pro"
status: sizeRates[1]: size "xs" is listed twice
status: storageMicrosPerGiBMonth must not be negative
status: downloadMicrosPerGiB must not be negative
status: sizeRates[0]: perHourMicros must not be negative

case: Subnet rates not named by slug
refusal: status: subnetSizeRates[0]: subnet: subnet slug must be exactly 12 characters
status: subnetSizeRates[1]: subnet "550000000003" is listed twice
spec: autoRefill can be enabled only with spendCapMicros set

case: allowance withheld for a reason not named
refusal: status: allowanceWithheld: unknown billing allowance withheld reason "unverified_email"
status: allowanceMicros must be zero while allowanceWithheld is set
reason is required once failed
effectiveAt is required in states applied and scheduled and absent otherwise, not in state applied
action is carried only while pending
action: url must be an absolute https URL with a host
